items.quote: Wir benötigen die Unterlagen spätestens am 7. Arbeitstag nach dem Briefdatum;
items.computation: Letter is dated 30.09.2025 (Tuesday). The insurer defines Arbeitstage as Monday-Friday excluding statutory public holidays, and the deadline is the 7th such day after the letter date (the letter date itself is not counted, per the insurer's own counting method). Counting forward from 01.10.2025: Wed 01.10 (1), Thu 02.10 (2), Fri 03.10 is Tag der Deutschen Einheit - skipped (national holiday), Sat 04.10 and Sun 05.10 skipped (weekend), Mon 06.10 (3), Tue 07.10 (4), Wed 08.10 (5), Thu 09.10 (6), Fri 10.10 (7). So the 7th business day is Friday, 10.10.2025.

warnings: If the OP-Bericht and physiotherapy prescription are not received by the insurer within the stated 7 working days, the letter states the insurer will reimburse only the already-substantiated items, not the full claim - worth submitting promptly or requesting an extension if more time is needed.
